what: The turbo rung (docs/state/roadmap.md, 'Owner decisions, 2026-09-05 evening', item 3): two step-reduction distills that are not PDD, each under sage alone with Sol absent, on the five ladder scenes at two seeds, blinded per seed against the sage 16-step floor. Arm turbov4: the larryvrh MiniMax-H3-Turbo v4 step-600 EMA at six steps through its own loader (bypass injection, strength 1.0, scheduler simple, shift 12/3), h3_probe_t2v_turbo_v4_sage. Arm turbolx12: lightx2v's fl2v turbo v1.2 768p 4-step file at the vendor's four steps, strength 1.0, shift 6/3, through the stock loader, h3_probe_t2v_turbo_lx12_sage. 1344x768, 345 frames. Neither LoRA has rendered in this repo before; the pack's node last ran on the mid-August core, so the warmup is its first test on this one.
why: The acceleration arena's text-to-video tab (internal/refs/SCR-20260905-khpk.png and siblings) puts the larryvrh v4 at six steps about two to one over the 28-step reference and over PDD8, with the lightx2v 8-step next; every 4-step entry sat in the bottom block. PDD8 lost to the sage floor here under sage alone and the bake did not move it, so PDD is parked and the step-reduction question moves to these two files.

scenes.diner: t2va_diner_breakup -- close-up two-person dialogue over scored music: the audio-judgeable one
scenes.opera: t2va_opera_grand_stage -- a sung Italian aria with a lyrics pair: the singing one
scenes.stairwell: t2va_stairwell_dialogue -- the shipped dialogue scene (DIALOGUE_T2V_PROMPT): two-person stairwell dialogue over a hard room tone, no music; added by the owner during the first run
scenes.subway: t2va_subway_chase -- fast tracking shot with strong shake, a fast push in, on-screen text: the fast-motion surface the review found the ladder missing

rungs.turbov4: larryvrh v4 step-600 EMA, 6 steps, strength 1.0, simple, shift 12/3, MiniMaxH3TurboLoRA bypass (low_vram off) + MiniMaxH3TurboSampler (stock Euler on this core), sage auto on every step, Sol absent (h3_probe_t2v_turbo_v4_sage)
rungs.turbolx12: lightx2v fl2v turbo 4-step v1.2 768p, 4 steps, strength 1.0, euler/simple, shift 6/3, LoraLoaderModelOnly, sage auto on every step, Sol absent (h3_probe_t2v_turbo_lx12_sage)

prompts: named by bank id through the runner's @bank: value; the text lives only in prompt_bank/

seeds.note: 730451892 is the ladder's seed, so the 2026-09-03 sage rows serve as the floor at that seed (cross-regime, as every ladder pair has been); 730451894 is new, chosen 2026-09-05 (the retime used 730451893), and the floor is rendered at it by bench/turbo_rung_floor_arms.json so every pair is same-seed and same-regime

reference_rows: seed 730451892: the <scene>_sage rows of bench/results/2026-09-03_ladder_arms_judged.jsonl; seed 730451894: this run's own floor rows from turbo_rung_floor_arms.json. Appended to the turbo JSONL per seed before blinding so blind_batch.py can pair them by run index.
run: turbo_rung_run.sh (untracked): run_graph_arms.py --manifest bench/turbo_rung_arms.json --runs 1 --hold-seed --no-alternate --warmup standoff_turbov4 at --seed 730451892 then at --seed 730451894, then --manifest bench/turbo_rung_floor_arms.json at --seed 730451894; outputs bench/results/2026-09-05_turbo_rung_s1.jsonl, _s2.jsonl, _floor_s2.jsonl. Then turbo_rung_blind.sh (untracked) per seed; the owner scores PAIRS only; bench/score_session.py.

pairs_that_are_controlled.sage (16 steps) vs turbov4: the pack distill's effect at six steps against the floor, same seed, same kernels, Sol absent on both
pairs_that_are_controlled.sage (16 steps) vs turbolx12: the lightx2v distill's effect at four steps and its own shift against the floor
pairs_that_are_controlled.turbov4 vs turbolx12: the two distills head to head, the arena's ordering tested on this repo's scenes

how_to_read: within a scene and seed only. Two seeds, so each contest has two independent stacks; read them as two samples, never pooled with the other scenes. Predict and record ADHERENCE apart from RENDERING QUALITY (docs/method/eval_comparison.md, judging section revised 2026-09-05): a half whose scene makes less sense for the prompt has adhered less. Free text over scales; 'same' means you would not care which you got. The brief names no expected defect.
cost: reasoned, not measured: the floor's sampler time per scene is in bench/results/2026-09-03_ladder_outputs.json; turbov4 runs six sage steps of sixteen plus the bypass adapter's cost per step, turbolx12 four of sixteen. Fifteen renders in the three runs above plus one warmup. Any timing is in the post-pull regime and is compared only with rows from that regime.
requires: a ComfyUI server up with this pack's graphs regenerated against the live /object_info; the larryvrh node pack loaded (MiniMaxH3TurboLoRA and MiniMaxH3TurboSampler in /object_info); the two LoRA files under models/loras/h3; the server unarmed (no H3_* keys but the capture root).
generated_by: workflows/build_workflows.py for both probe graphs; regenerate there, never edit the graph
policy: sage always on (owner decision 2026-09-04); both arms rendered under sage alone so Sol is not in the comparison. Two seeds allowed again (owner decision 2026-09-05 evening).

predictions.written: 2026-09-05 evening, by the bake lane, before any render; the reasoning is the arena reading in the session's postmortem and docs/distills/ref2v_distillation.md's header measurements of the two files
predictions.adherence: turbov4 adheres at least as well as the floor on the four slow scenes and the subway text survives on it at one seed of two; turbolx12 loses adherence against the floor on at least two of five scenes per seed, the dialogue and text scenes first (standoff sign, subway sign), because 4-step distills sat in the arena's bottom block on both tabs
predictions.rendering_quality: turbov4 reads same-as-floor on at least three of the four slow scenes per seed and loses on the subway chase (its README names motion smear at low counts; six is its floor for that); turbolx12 loses to the floor on fine detail and text on most scenes; turbov4 beats turbolx12 head to head on at least three of five scenes per seed
predictions.audio: both arms' audio level within the floor's (measure it: bench/measure_clip_loudness.py); turbov4's audio preferred over turbolx12's where they differ; neither arm's audio is judged quieter the way PDD8's was
predictions.what_refutes: turbov4 losing to the floor on three or more slow scenes at both seeds means the arena result does not transfer to these scenes, and the rung closes; turbolx12 matching the floor means the 4-step penalty read off the arena is the arena's, not the file's
predictions.cost_expectation: turbov4 well under half the floor's sampler time and turbolx12 under a third; if the pack's bypass adapter costs more than the six-step saving, the record shows it and the arm's place on the frontier is decided by that, not by the eye
